messages:
incident-bot: P1 pager firing: massive serving errors in runtime-prod (CUDA_OOM + container crashes). Incident INC-3654321. Paging @Maria @Sam @Leo @Ash. Please acknowledge.

Maria (oncall): ack. I'm oncall — assessing. What are the immediate symptoms?

Sam (eng-runtime): seeing an autoscale spike 15:02->15:05; replicas jumped from 7 to 26, then a bunch of pods crashed during model init with CUDA OOM. Stack traces show allocator failures during KV cache warmup. Investigating logs now.

Leo (eng-sre): infra metrics: multiple node flaps in us-west1-gpu between 15:04-15:07. NVML reset events and GPU driver warnings correlate with pod restarts.

Ash (eng-platform): autoscaler details: HPA reacted to a burst from a sandbox customer. No scale-down damping configured on this GPU pool; short spike caused overshoot. Recommend throttling HPA and adding stabilization to avoid oscillation.

Maria (oncall): do the throttle now. Ash — post the patch commands.

Ash (eng-platform): patching HPA now:
```
kubectl patch hpa runtime-serving-gpu -n prod --type merge -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":12}}'
kubectl annotate hpa runtime-serving-gpu -n prod autoscaler.stabilization=180
```

deploy-bot: Patch applied by @Ash at 2026-03-15T15:08:21Z -> maxReplicas=12, annotated stabilization=180 :white_check_mark:

Sam (eng-runtime): sample crash log from pod runtime-serving-9f2c (trimmed):
```
E c10d/cuda_driver.cc: failed to allocate 536870912 bytes: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
W allocator.cpp: failed to allocate kv cache block
F runtime/main.cc: assert(kv_cache) failed
terminate called after throwing: std::bad_alloc
Aborted (core dumped)
```

Carla (support): customer impact: error spikes produced ~14% of gen calls returning 5xx in 15:00-15:12. Several support cases from enterprise account "Northbridge" reporting elevated latency and failed requests. I'm drafting a customer-facing note.

Maria (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) cap autoscale (done), 2) start a controlled rolling restart with memory-safe envs, 3) temporarily route non-critical traffic to small-model fallback, 4) isolate flapping nodes. Sam — prepare the restart + env change.

Sam (eng-runtime): applying env tweaks to reduce allocator fragmentation and opt for quantized model flavor:
```
kubectl set env deployment/runtime-serving -n prod PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:128 MODEL_FALLBACK=8bit-lite --record
kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime-serving -n prod --strategy=RollingUpdate
```
I'll restart 2 pods at a time and monitor init OOMs.

Leo (eng-sre): cordoning nodes with repeated GPU resets: gw-usw1-12 and gw-usw1-19. Draining gracefully to avoid noisy neighbors. Scheduling driver reimage for gw-usw1-12.

Ash (eng-platform): also implemented a quick router rule to divert sandbox traffic: /generate from requests with header X-Customer-Type:sandbox -> model-small at 40% traffic. Verifying on routing dashboard.

deploy-bot: Rollout update: runtime-serving rolling restart started; 4/24 pods restarted.

Sam (eng-runtime): observed first batch of restarts: OOMs during init dropped significantly. New pods initialize slower but succeed. Per-pod GPU memory usage down ~25%.

Maria (oncall): good. Keep rolling. Leo — confirm node cordon status.

Leo (eng-sre): cordoned gw-usw1-12, gw-usw1-19; drain completed. Marked gw-usw1-12 for immediate reimage due to NVML resets. Added alert: nvml_reset_count > 2/hr -> pager.

Carla (support): customer message draft: "We observed a brief autoscaling surge that coincided with GPU OOMs during model warmup, causing intermittent 5xxs between 15:00-15:12. Engineers throttled scaling, applied memory-safe settings to model servers, and routed non-critical traffic to fallback models. Impact: intermittent failures for ~12 minutes; remediation in progress and RCA underway." Sending after oncall approval.

Sam (eng-runtime): health metrics: error rate fell from 18% -> 2.5% within 8 minutes of rolling restart. No new crashloops observed on patched pods.

Maria (oncall): wrap-up mitigation summary for incident log: - HPA maxReplicas reduced to 12 and stabilization set to 180s - Rolling restart with PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:128 and MODEL_FALLBACK=8bit-lite - Sandbox traffic diverted to small model fallback at 40% - Cordoned two flapping nodes; one scheduled for reimage - Alerts added for NVML reset frequency and autoscaler oscillation

Ash (eng-platform): follow-ups: add scale-down cooldown and damping to GPU HPA, widen autoscaler metric window to smooth short spikes, implement per-customer rate-limiter for sandboxing. Target: 24h.

Sam (eng-runtime): follow-ups: collect CUDA traces, pytorch allocator dumps, and KV cache warmup profiles from failed pods; write a runbook section for memory-safe startup. Owner: Sam. ETA: EOD.

Leo (eng-sre): follow-ups: reimage gw-usw1-12, monitor NVML reset alert for 24h. Owner: Leo. ETA: 12h.

Carla (support): action: send customer update and escalate Northbridge case. Track tickets.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-3654321 -> mitigated. Pager resolved for oncall at 2026-03-15T15:28:40Z. Monitoring continues.

Maria (oncall): closing thread unless error rate regresses. Postmortem owner: Sam. Thanks team :thumbsup:
